ipo_status: Priced: Anthropic priced its IPO on 2026-11-18 at $83.00 per Class A share (above the $70-$78 range), upsized to 980,000,000 shares (956,351,354 new, 23,648,646 from selling stockholders); registration statement declared effective by the SEC on 2026-11-18; trading expected to begin on the Nasdaq Global Select Market as "ANT" on 2026-11-19; closing expected 2026-11-20; underwriters hold a 30-day option for up to 147,000,000 additional shares. Source: Anthropic press release. Final prospectus (424B4) not yet on EDGAR as of 2026-11-18; first trade pending.

changelog.change: v1: IPO status, timeline, valuation range, proceeds, underwriters, run-rate revenue, derived multiples. Two primary sources from anthropic.com.

Status updated from confidential draft to public S-1 (2026-10-26), Nasdaq ANT; underwriter syndicate from the S-1 cover (primary). IPO valuation and proceeds targets remain press-reported because the price range is blank.

Price range $70-$78 and 825M shares from S-1/A No. 3; implied market cap $916B-$1,021B (price x 13,086,672,593 shares outstanding after the offering and concurrent placement, not fully diluted); $26.0B concurrent private placement; listing approved. Press-reported $1.8-2.0T valuation target marked superseded.

Priced: $83.00 per share, 980M shares (956.35M new + 23.65M selling stockholders), 147M underwriter option, from Anthropic's pricing press release (primary). Implied market cap at $83 ~= $1.096T on basic shares outstanding re-based to final terms; press $1.4-1.5T is fully diluted. Final prospectus and first trade pending. Added reported fully diluted valuation (~$1.5T) as the like-for-like anchor for valuation-quoted perps.
